tools.name: qoblex_get_current_user
tools.description: Return the user that owns the API key: id, name, email, timezone and permissions. Good first call to confirm the connection. Qoblex API: GET /v1/users/me.

tools.name: qoblex_get_account
tools.description: Return the Qoblex account (company) details and settings for this key. Qoblex API: GET /v1/account.

tools.name: qoblex_list_products
tools.description: List products in the catalogue, with optional filters, sorting and related records (variants, images, mappings). Qoblex API: GET /v1/products.

tools.name: qoblex_get_product
tools.description: Return one product by id, optionally with related records expanded. Qoblex API: GET /v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: qoblex_list_variants
tools.description: List product variants (the stock-keeping level: size, colour, SKU), with optional filters and sorting. Qoblex API: GET /v1/variants.

tools.name: qoblex_get_variant_inventory
tools.description: Return the stock levels for one product variant, including incoming stock. Qoblex API: GET /v1/variants/{id}/inventory.

tools.name: qoblex_list_sale_orders
tools.description: List sale orders with their line items, shipments, invoices and status. Filter by status (Quote, Open, Closed, Canceled) and by creation or update date. Qoblex API: GET /v1/sale_orders.

tools.name: qoblex_get_sale_order
tools.description: Return one sale order by id, with line items, status and related records when expanded. Qoblex API: GET /v1/sale_orders/{id}.

tools.name: qoblex_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders sent to suppliers, with optional filters, sorting and related records (for example the supplier). Qoblex API: GET /v1/purchase_orders.

tools.name: qoblex_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Return one purchase order by id, optionally with related records expanded. Qoblex API: GET /v1/purchase_orders/{id}.

tools.name: qoblex_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, with optional filters and sorting. Qoblex API: GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: qoblex_get_customer
tools.description: Return one customer by id. Qoblex API: GET /v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: qoblex_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers, with optional filters and sorting. Qoblex API: GET /v1/suppliers.

tools.name: qoblex_get_supplier
tools.description: Return one supplier by id. Qoblex API: GET /v1/suppliers/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qoblex_get_current_user · Private data: qoblex_get_current_user, qoblex_list_products, qoblex_get_product, qoblex_get_sale_order, qoblex_list_purchase_orders, qoblex_get_purchase_order · Public sink: qoblex_get_current_user.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: qoblex_get_current_user · Private data: qoblex_get_current_user, qoblex_list_products, qoblex_get_product, qoblex_get_sale_order, qoblex_list_purchase_orders, qoblex_get_purchase_order · Public sink: qoblex_get_current_user

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
